notes.title: Update + Farabel
notes.notes:
We pushed a quick update for MiniOne Racing to fix some small issues and optimise the loading.

Today we're also releasing our new game, Farabel!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200

[quote][b]Farabel is a turn based strategy game in which you start at the end of the story. But that’s not all. In Farabel, the whole gaming experience is turned around.[/b]
You start out the adventure with a hero at maximum power, and with each jump into the past, your character is left with a slightly weaker body. At the same time, the game become more and more complexe. Develop your cleverness, your strategic prowess, and your inventive capabilities![/quote]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22635566/03f7b1c7cec8cef02eea1d2fa6182c29dee13458.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Farabel, the game that starts out at the end
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/Gif_Diablotin2.gif[/img]

Our new game, Farabel releases on PC, Mac, and Linux October 14.
As usual, it's a refreshing and fun to play game. But it's also the most innovative game we ever made: Farabel is a turn-based strategy game that starts out at the end!

Stay tuned, [b]watch the new trailer[/b], add the game to your Whislist and learn more on farabel.com

notes.title: Faster cars!
notes.notes:
We've tweaked the whole game to have faster cars.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bmbmuRf.gif[/img]
Every league (from 50 to 200cc) should feel and play faster than before.


We found out that very few people know that you have 3 different camera positions, just hit the tab key to change it.

Oh, and [b]MiniOne Racing is on sale (50% off) for a few days[/b].
http://store.steampowered.com/app/380000

notes.title: MiniOne Racing is live on Steam
notes.notes:
Welcome to all new racers!

MiniOne Racing is a thrilling racing game which lets players drive colorful, humorous miniature vehicles around various locations created by a kid: beach, playground... and even other planet!

MiniOne Racing is first and foremost a single player game, but you can also race against friends. Remember to read this "[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/380000/discussions/0/523890046868907021/]how to[/url]" before hosting a multiplayer game.

MiniOne Racing might be an old game, but it's still a fun arcade playground for kids (and adults who just want a simple & fun racing game)!

notes.title: 4 days left!
notes.notes:
In less than 4 days MoR will be available on Steam.
This is our second game one Steam after [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/11280]Penguins Arena[/url].
http://store.steampowered.com/app/11280

A few weeks ago we had the opportunity to publish this game on Steam, it wasn't an easy decision as it looks like.
We initially released MoR in the end of 2008 so it's kind of an old game.
We didn't made a game specifically for kids but we're conscious of our game *looks* like this. We had concerns if it would fit the Steam catalog. 

That being said we're pretty confident that MiniOne Racing will be loved by some of you, kids or not!

MiniOne Racing will run on any hardware, it's family-friendly and have some interesting gameplay mechanics.

See you in 4 days, and remember that any tweet/review/post is helpful! <3
